activation.note: Activation covers valid and invalid specs of every authorable kind, distinguishes Compose value checks from kept-unit completeness at Ratify, and retains advisory, promoted and schema-less cases. Findings are explicitly outcomes rather than prerequisites. Tool-call and unit-kind observability is plausible from the source; phase, kept status and outcomes conservatively require new observers. The exclusion of generated artifacts is declared and matches the hand-authored scope.

audit.summary: All 39 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with operational decisions retained in coder-facing text and detailed measurements and history retained in verifier detail. The advisory exception is source-authored, the then expresses one staged schema-validity obligation, and no content is displaced into shared nodes.

segmentChecks.note: The hand-authored scope, Compose/Ratify split, and by-construction rationale survive across given, when, then, and why.
The then and verifier detail retain all four carried-value constraints and their Compose timing.
Verifier detail preserves both the immediate-defect rationale and the session-lifecycle basis for Compose refusal.
All four completeness constraints, the kept-unit restriction, Ratify timing, and pre-lock placement are retained.
The add_unit upsert drafting loop and the distinction between an unfinished draft and a Ratify defect remain explicit.
The schema-fidelity criterion for an enforced kind and its blocking/RAISE behavior are preserved.
All four default enforced kinds are coder-facing, while the exact validation counts remain in verifier detail.
Advisory reporting without blocking, compaction survival, Ratify resurfacing, both default kinds and counts, and the wmbt comment all survive.
The exact plan.spec_validation.enforce configuration path and promotion effect are retained.
The prohibition on silently ungoverned authorable kinds is explicit in evidence, activation, avoid, and verifier detail.
Both the writer-validator fallback and the explicit unchecked report rather than silent clean are preserved.
Verifier detail retains the contract meta-schema explanation, check_unit_spec gap, three validator rules, 14 contracts, and issue lineage.
Pre-lock Ratify validation, unlocked-on-failure atomicity, and the analogous gate contract are retained.

risks: The coder-facing text is dense at 1531 characters; the broad instruction to keep every spec schema-valid must be read with the unless clause so advisory feature/wmbt findings are not incorrectly treated as blocking.
For nondefault kinds, the agent still needs the repository's promotion configuration and enforced/advisory classification; the coder-facing fields give the rule but not a lookup procedure.

unobservable: Plan-session phase (plan:Compose versus plan:Ratify), explicitly declared needs_new_observer.
Kept versus dropped unit status at Ratify, explicitly declared needs_new_observer.
The check_unit_spec finding/outcome, explicitly declared needs_new_observer.
Whether a kind is listed under plan.spec_validation.enforce in .atdd/config.yaml; promotion is described but has no dedicated activation fact.
Whether a nondefault kind's schema describes or has drifted from the artifacts atdd authors; this classification is not reduced to an observable fact.
Whether an artifact outside a plan session was generated by atdd author rather than hand-authored, as required by the doesNotFire scope.

review.summary: The sampled operational knowledge is preserved at its claimed destinations, and the auditor's PASS is justified. The staged coder decision is clear, although fully deterministic activation requires the declared new observers and explicit facts for kind promotion/classification and generated-versus-hand-authored scope.
